verdict.rationale: Gram's documented platform MCP server lets an agent in an MCP client "find and add MCP servers" without the dashboard. This is a first-party programmatic interface onto the catalog, which is backed by the official MCP Registry. However, it is framed around org-admin workflows, no catalog query API or schema is documented, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on all candidate paths. missing for 10: documented REST/OpenAPI catalog query API, explicit tool-level discovery/search endpoints and response schemas, hands-on corroboration of agent-driven discovery.

support.subject: As an AI agent, I can query the platform's registry or catalog through a documented API to discover servers and tools programmatically

citations.quote: An org admin working in Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or another MCP client can find and add MCP servers
Discover and import official third-party MCP servers, powered by the official MCP Registry.
One catalog of approved tools, provisioned by team and role through the identity provider you already run
